listed_quote.quote: Annual Meeting of Shareholders of DCA Total Return Fund (NYSE: DCA) and DCW Total Return Fund (NYSE: DCW) (each a “Fund” and together, the “Funds”)

announcement.quote: The Reorganization will not be consummated unless it is approved by the stockholders of both DCA and DCW.

deals.notes: Proposed 2010 reorganization of DCW into DCA (N-14 filed 2010-06-28, amended twice 2010-07-30; annual meeting set for September 16, 2010). The 2010-08-27 425 shareholder letter is cut off before it lists the proposals. The 2011-2012 filings shown (DCA adviser change to Virtus, renamed Virtus Total Return Fund) do not mention DCW or the reorganization in the excerpts, so no outcome is stated; completion is not inferred from silence.
